steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $9.11B (to $15.13B) × margin 12.3% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $4.85B
K = capital to build it: $9.11B ÷ sales-to-capital 1.65 = $5.53B
σ = 77% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $3.07B
assets in place = NOPAT $666.4M ÷ WACC = $5.37B; value = ($5.37B + $3.07B − net debt $599.8M) ÷ 145,967,000 = $53.72
